Highlights

Highlights

Five Permanently Sealed Burners

With a variety of BTU ratings including a new fifth burner, this range can handle all of your surface cooking needs.

Large Capacity Oven

Featuring the industry’s largest capacity at 4.7 cu. ft., the oven provides ample space to handle everything from everyday meals to holiday feasts.

Vari-Speed Dual Flow™ Convection

Maximize air flow and fluffiness with Vari-Speed Dual Flow™ Convection system. Two-speed convection system capable of turning the fan in both directions. This combined with the largest convection fan blades in the industry provides maximum airflow.

Continuous Grate

Itís a breeze to slide stew laden pots or to utilize multiple burners with the heavy-duty virtually continuous grate surface.

TruGlide™ Oven Racks

Easily extend and hold heavy items on any rack level with the help of roller bearing glides.

SureSpark™ Ignition System

From low to high, the exclusive SureSpark™ ignition system lights every time.
